waiting_on.subject: Đang chạy script release 2.123.0 (chạy test, gắn tag, đẩy code, chờ CI). Có kết quả tôi sẽ báo ngay.

cells.title: Publish release 2.123.0 through the sanctioned script
cells.action: Run `scripts/release.sh 2.123.0` with BEE_DISPATCH_ID set to an authorized deployment dispatch and the CI-pinned opencode 1.18.16 (/mnt/data/Projects/goglbe/beehive/.bee/tmp/oc11816/bin) first on PATH and CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/thanhsmind/.cache/cargo-target-rel21230, so the opencode contract tests run green. The script bumps both plugin manifests, runs the regen chain (render-skill-trees, onboard --apply, release-manifest --write), runs the declared test suite before tagging, makes the release commit, tags v2.123.0, pushes main and the tag, waits for the release-binaries workflow and verifies the published assets. Never walk those steps by hand. Re-running at a version already committed is idempotent — it resumes the tail. The regen obligation on .claude-plugin/plugin.json is discharged INSIDE the script's own regen chain, which is why the release manifest rides this cell's files.

truths: tag v2.123.0 exists locally and on the remote
the GitHub release for v2.123.0 carries the binaries and SHA256SUMS
the script printed its final OK line
key_links: the pushed tag is what triggers release-binaries.yml
prohibitions: Do not hand-walk bump, tag or push
Do not skip the test gate

cells.title: Check the published 2.123.0 release
cells.action: Check the release independently, read-only: both plugin manifests on main report 2.123.0; tag v2.123.0 exists locally and on origin (git ls-remote --tags origin v2.123.0); the GitHub release v2.123.0 lists the five binaries and SHA256SUMS (gh release view v2.123.0 --json assets); the release-binaries run for v2.123.0 concluded success. Write each check with its command and output to docs/history/release-2-123-0/reports/rel21230-1c.md and commit it with the trailer cell: rel21230-1c. Bee commands you may run: bee herding notify; never bee dispatch.
cells.verify: gh release view v2.123.0 --json assets --jq '.assets | length'

truths: the report shows each of the four checks with its command and output
prohibitions: No edit outside the report file
